notes: Professor Euler 7.1.4: Ask your AI has a third choice, Cut-out. It sends the selected exercise as its cut-out to your own AI app (Gemini, ChatGPT and others): the context marked for it, the exercise, the book's solution where there is one, and your sheet if you like. Nothing needs marking, and no API key is needed. For a hint or a check of your own work, your AI app is told to use the solution only as a reference and not to give it away.
